title: HaltRecord
description: Written to calls/<call-id>/halt-record.json (and referenced from run-state) whenever a run halts.

exitCode.description: the mapped public CLI exit code (0-8)

reasonCode.description: STABLE MACHINE code for the halt — lower_snake, never a sentence (e.g. adapter_exited_nonzero, containment_mutation_detected, scope_write_denied, scope_outside_root, cancelled, outer_cycle_cap_reached). Note that NO model-identity classification produces a halt record: identity is recorded as a caveat on the run and the response is used (see ../model-identity.md). An unclassified fault still yields a code derived from its exit code (usage_error, configuration_error, adapter_unavailable, containment_breach, policy_halt, internal_error), so this field is never prose. The human rendering lives in `detail`.

signal.description: Classified actionability hint for the underlying tool invocation, when the failure produced one (meshcore/clihint). Absent when nothing classified. It answers 'what can the operator do', where reasonCode answers 'what went wrong'.

detail.description: the human-readable rendering of the halt (message plus any wrapped cause)
